items.title: Introducing queue consumption mode for Apache Kafka in AWS Lambda
items.summary: AWS Lambda event source mappings now support queue consumption mode for Apache Kafka. Using Kafka Share Groups, you can scale consumer parallelism independently of partition count, with per-record acknowledgment, visibility timeouts, and automatic retries on self-managed Kafka 4.2 or later clusters.
items.creator: Vaibhav Jain
